goal: GAP SWEEP (wave 5b): every listed depth_target is currently not_simulated/config_only in the shipped console. Build each one on a REAL backend (Nano + offline) and lift its capability level to full or limited. 'Out of Vyomi's scope', 'separate product', 'single-account' or 'not modeled' are NOT acceptable reasons: model it in the shared core (Python core/*_core.py, vendored to wasm), wire it through the native wire, enforce behaviour (not stored config), and make the console section live. depth_targets.title: Write to BigQuery / write to Cloud Storage delivery
depth_targets.current_reason: BigQuery and Cloud Storage aren't Vyomi products yet, so there is nowhere for this delivery type to write. Choose Pull or Push instead.

depth_targets.title: Topic ingestion from external sources (AWS/Azure/Kafka/CDC)
depth_targets.current_reason: Vyomi has no connectors to AWS, Azure, Kafka or database CDC sources, so a topic can't be configured to ingest from them.

depth_targets.title: Message transforms (JavaScript UDFs on publish)
depth_targets.current_reason: Vyomi does not run a JavaScript transform pipeline on published messages.

depth_targets.current_reason: Vyomi does not collect the time-series metrics (throughput, backlog, oldest unacked age) the console's Metrics tab charts.
